rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that lasts a long time and resists wear.

example.english: These shoes are quite durable; even after wearing them for a year, they’re still pretty new.
example.traditional: 呢對鞋幾襟用，着咗成年都仲好新。
